subject.title: improve(control-ui): expose linear session positions in chat picker

question: Should maintainers land this narrow Control UI chat picker accessibility slice after conflict resolution while leaving the broader linear workspace accessibility request open?
rationale: The patch is focused and proven, but it changes user-facing accessibility wording, has a protected maintainer label, and only partially overlaps a larger product/accessibility request.

options.title: Land Narrow Slice
options.body: Approve the selector row-number and aria-label affordance after the branch is refreshed and required checks pass, without treating it as the full workspace solution.

options.title: Request UX Wording Changes
options.body: Ask for different visible ordinal treatment or screen-reader phrasing before merge if maintainers want a different accessibility pattern.

options.title: Pause For Broader Design
options.body: Hold this PR until the linear persistent workspace direction is decided, accepting that this smaller picker improvement waits.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow Slice
recommendation.body: Approve the selector row-number and aria-label affordance after the branch is refreshed and required checks pass, without treating it as the full workspace solution.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent localization work on the changed ChatPane/i18n surface makes this the best available routing candidate for the refresh and merge-shape decision.
